completionChecks.label: Body is carrying the scene
completionChecks.fix: Add concrete body and sensation details. At least 60% of sentences should be physically grounded.

completionChecks.label: Motion has happened
completionChecks.fix: Move one body part one more time. The scene needs physical action.

completionChecks.label: Scene has enough mass
completionChecks.fix: Keep going. This is probably still an entry fragment. Scenes need mass.

completionChecks.label: Explanation not taking over
completionChecks.fix: Cut the explanation. Return to body. The scene explains itself through sensation.

completionChecks.label: Scene ends on a physical stop
completionChecks.fix: End on stillness, failed motion, breath, weight, cold, or silence.
